overall: The AG found no violation: the chair's communications with the agent and drafting of a letter did not constitute a quorum deliberation. The AG separately reminded the Board of its agenda and minutes obligations without ordering any remedy.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board deliberated outside an open meeting on sending a sewer/Title 5 inspection letter and its contents.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, we find that there was no improper deliberation and therefore no violation of the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Not raised in the complaint: the AG noted concerns that agendas lacked time/location and minutes were sparse.
allegations.key_passage: While the issue was not raised in the complaint, we note our serious concerns about the sufficiency of the agendas and meeting minutes provided by the Board.
